# Amoghasiddhi walks into a faith & spiritual organizations firm

The faith & spiritual organizations world does not cite Amoghasiddhi in its documentation. It does not need to — it performs the archetype daily, unbilled.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Origins.** Amoghasiddhi appears in buddhist tradition as infallible success, north.  The name's meaning, "'Unfailing Accomplishment' — the fifth Dhyānibuddha, lord of the karma family", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Amoghasiddhi in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.
